description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git p4' commands, specifically focusing on the exclusion of paths during clone and sync operations involving Perforce depot paths.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Initializes and starts a local Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up git repositories created during tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if the specified path does not exist.
